instruction: Activate notifications on the lock screen so I can check for updates at a glance.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires enabling notifications on the lock screen. The config disables show-in-lock-screen (false), and the agent must enable it (true). This is the inverse of variation 3, maintaining similar difficulty and using the same evaluation pattern.
metadata.verification:
Verified that gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-in-lock-screen returns 'true
' or 'false
'. The evaluator checks for 'true
' to confirm lock screen notifications are enabled.
